description: If a partial recursion is defined at index \(n\), it is defined at every earlier index \(i\le n\) with the same parameters.

  (x : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.Args k) {i n : ℕ} (hin : i ≤ n)
  (hd :
    (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.partialRec g h
        (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.snoc x n)).Dom) :
